worldcombat.skill.bloodmoon.summary: Call a full moon that shines red as blood and pour the user's whole spirit into a column of light falling straight onto the foe's ground, leaving a scorched ring. Once spent, it cannot be called again for a while; using another move lets the spirit settle early. Eclipse style spreads the moonlight around the impact, at some cost to the primary hit.
worldcombat.skill.bloodmoon.use.0: Call a full moon and drop its column straight down
worldcombat.skill.bloodmoon.use.1: Pick off a far, bulky target
worldcombat.skill.bloodmoon.use.2: Use eclipse style to catch a whole patch at the impact

worldcombat.skill.bloodmoon.preference.a: Beyond this distance it will not call the moon and closes in first.
Below this health fraction it will not call the moon unless the target is nearly down. Higher values make it more protective and less likely to finish a weakened foe.
On (with eclipse style): it calls the moon more readily when other enemies stand near the target, since the moonlight can pour over a whole patch; off ranks by the single-target payoff only.
